form.label: Imperva IOC Block V2 – older detections
form.description: IPs whose last detection is older than 7 days and that are not blocked yet. Same as the Block page: click rows to select, fill Ticket / Incident no. and Description, click ⛔ BLOCK.

search.query: `imperva_ioc_detections` | where last_seen < relative_time(now(), $h_cut|s$) | eval _r=$h_refresh|s$
| `imperva_audit_daily(30)` | eval _r=$h_refresh|s$

panel.title: Blocked / unblocked IPs per day – last 30 days

search.query: | fields _time "Blocked IPs" "Unblocked IPs"

html.div: IPs detected again in the last 7 days are on the Block – last 7 days page.

search.query: | makeresults | eval _q=replace(lower(trim(replace($h_q|s$, "[*]", ""))), "^ithm[\s:#-]*", "") | eval ip=split(replace(_q, "[\s,;]+", ","), ",") | mvexpand ip | where ip!="" | eval _isip=if(match(ip, "^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}(/\d{1,2})?\z") OR (match(ip, ":") AND match(ip, "^[0-9a-f:.]+(/\d{1,3})?\z")), 1, 0) | eventstats sum(_isip) AS _nip | where _isip=1 OR _nip=0 | eval _text=if(_nip=0, _q, null()), ip=if(_nip=0, null(), ip), _k=coalesce(ip, "text") | dedup _k | impervafind field=ip text_field=_text | eval ip=coalesce(ip, "-") | join type=left ip [search `imperva_ioc_notables` earliest=-90d@d [| makeresults | eval _q=replace(lower(trim(replace($h_q|s$, "[*]", ""))), "^ithm[\s:#-]*", ""), t=split(replace(_q, "[\s,;]+", ","), ",") | mvexpand t | where match(t, "^[0-9a-f.:]+\z") AND match(t, "[.:]") | stats count AS n values(t) AS t | eval search=if(n>0, "(".mvjoin(mvmap(t, "\"".t."\""), " OR ").")", "\"imperva_no_ip_typed\"") | fields search] | `imperva_ioc_ip` | mvexpand ioc_ip | `imperva_ioc_fields` | stats max(_time) AS _det_last values(ioc_rule) AS _det_rule values(ioc_incident) AS _det_inc BY ioc_ip | rename ioc_ip AS ip] | eval _det_inc=mvdedup(mvmap(_det_inc, replace(_det_inc, "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", ""))) | eval found=find_lines.if(isnotnull(_det_last), " ‖ pg¦detected ".strftime(_det_last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")." · ".mvjoin(_det_rule, "; ").if(isnotnull(_det_inc), " · ticket ".mvjoin(_det_inc, ", "), "")." · on the ".if(_det_last>=relative_time(now(), "-7d@d"), "Block – last 7 days", "Older detections")." page", "") | table ip found find_blockable find_cloud

input.label: 🔎 Search or add IPs – IP / Ticket / Incident no. / Rule (* = all)
Add IPs manually – other sources, comma separated ("-" if none)

search.query: | eval _q=replace(lower(trim(replace($h_q|s$, "[*]", ""))), "^ithm[\s:#-]*", ""), _toks=split(replace(_q, "[\s,;]+", ","), ","), _hay=lower(src." ".incident_no." ".rule_name) | eval _ntok=mvcount(mvfilter(_toks!="")), _iptok=mvcount(mvfilter(match(_toks, "^[0-9a-f.:/]+\z") AND match(_toks, "[.:]"))) | eval _hit=if(coalesce(_iptok, 0)>0 AND _iptok=_ntok, coalesce(mvcount(mvmap(_toks, if(_toks!="" AND like(_hay, "%"._toks."%"), 1, null()))), 0), 0) | where _q="" OR _hit>0 OR like(_hay, "%"._q."%") | sort - _sev_rank - count | head 50 | stats count AS shown_n values(src) AS shown | eval SelectAll=if(shown_n>0, "☑ Select all ".shown_n." shown: ".mvjoin(shown, ","), "-") | eval ip=split("-,".replace(trim($h_sel|s$, ","), "☑ Select all \d+ shown: ", ""), ",") | mvexpand ip | eventstats count AS _c BY ip | eval ip=if(ip!="" AND ip!="-" AND _c%2=1, ip, null()) | stats first(SelectAll) AS SelectAll values(ip) AS ip | eval ips=coalesce(mvjoin(ip, ","), ""), n=if(ips="", 0, coalesce(mvcount(split(ips, ",")), 0)) | eval nb_ips=ips, nb_n=n | eval _add=trim(replace($h_add|s$, "[\s;]+", ","), ","), _add=if(_add="-", "", _add) | eval ips=trim(coalesce(ips, "").",".replace(_add, ",+", ","), ","), ips=coalesce(mvjoin(mvdedup(split(ips, ",")), ","), "") | eval ips=if(ips=",", "", ips), n=if(ips="", 0, coalesce(mvcount(split(ips, ",")), 0)) | eval ip=if(n=0, "-", split(ips, ",")) | mvexpand ip | impervapolicycheck field=ip | vtcheck field=ip check_waf=false cache_only=true | eval _cloud=if(ip!="-" AND (match(lower(coalesce(vt_as_owner, "")), `imperva_cloud_providers`) OR match(lower(coalesce(vt_as_owner, "")), `imperva_mobile_providers`)), ip, null()) | lookup imperva_block_registry ip OUTPUT status AS _reg | eval chk=case(ip="-" OR ip="", null(), isnotnull(_cloud), ip." is a CLOUD PROVIDER / SHARED IP (".vt_as_owner.") - short block: unblocked automatically after a few days without an attack", NOT (match(ip, "^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}(/\d{1,2})?\z") OR (match(ip, ":") AND match(ip, "^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]+(/\d{1,3})?\z"))), ip." is not an IP / CIDR", isnotnull(mvfind(_reg, "^blocked\z")), ip." already blocked from Splunk", waf_policy_verdict="ALLOWLISTED", ip." is ALLOWED: ".waf_policies, waf_policy_verdict="BLOCKED_ELSEWHERE" OR waf_policy_verdict="BLOCKED_HERE", ip." already BLOCKED: ".waf_policies, waf_policy_verdict="UNKNOWN", ip." WAF check unavailable", true(), null()) | stats first(SelectAll) AS SelectAll first(ips) AS ips first(n) AS n first(nb_ips) AS nb_ips first(nb_n) AS nb_n values(chk) AS waf_check values(_cloud) AS cloud_ips | eval ips=coalesce(ips, ""), n=coalesce(n, 0), nb_ips=coalesce(nb_ips, ""), nb_n=coalesce(nb_n, 0), cloud_ips=coalesce(mvjoin(cloud_ips, ","), "") | eval waf_check=coalesce(mvjoin(waf_check, " | "), if(n=0, "-", "✔ none blocked / allowed on WAF")) | eval nb_n=coalesce(nb_n, 0), NotBlock=if(nb_n>0, "✖ NOT BLOCK ".nb_n." IP".if(nb_n=1, "", "s").": ".replace(nb_ips, ",", ", "), "-") | eval Action=if(n=0, "Click rows below or type IPs in the search box", "⛔ BLOCK ".n." IP".if(n=1, "", "s")), Clear=if(n=0, "-", "✖ Clear selection") | eval selected_ips=if(n=0, "-", replace(ips, ",", ", ")), ticket=$h_tk|s$, description=$h_desc|s$ | eval ticket=if(ticket="-" AND match($h_q|s$, "(?i)^\s*(ITHM[\s:#-]*)?\d{6,}\s*\z"), replace(trim($h_q|s$), "(?i)^ITHM[\s:#-]*", ""), ticket) | table Action NotBlock Clear SelectAll selected_ips waf_check cloud_ips ticket description

panel.title: Block result – written to the audit log (click a row to close)

search.query: | makeresults | impervablock action=block ip=$h_exec_ips|s$ incident_no=$h_exec_tk|s$ description=$h_exec_desc|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status verified ticket description backend soar_container detail

panel.title: Not block result – hidden until detected again, nothing sent to the WAF (click a row to close)

search.query: | impervadismiss action=add ip=$h_nb_exec|s$ incident_no=$h_nb_tk|s$ description=$h_nb_desc|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status ticket description detail
`imperva_waf_events` src=$h_detail|s$ | `imperva_waf_action_class` | `imperva_waf_request_fields` | bin _time span=1d | stats count BY _time waf_class waf_atk waf_code waf_path waf_client waf_ua

| where src=$h_detail|s$ | `imperva_ioc_enrich_30d` | `imperva_ioc_decision_aid(30d)` | intelcheck field=src cache_only=true adjust=false | eval AbuseIPDB=if(abuse_status="ok", abuse_score."% · ".abuse_reports." reports · ".abuse_users." users · ".abuse_usage." · ".abuse_isp.if(abuse_tor="yes", " · Tor", "").if(abuse_last_reported!="-", " · last ".abuse_last_reported, ""), abuse_status) | eval GreyNoise=case(gn_status="ok" AND gn_riot="yes", "RIOT known service · ".gn_name, gn_status="ok", gn_classification." · ".gn_name." · last seen ".gn_last_seen, gn_status="not_found", "not observed scanning the internet", true(), gn_status) | eval Close="✖ Close", Events="🔍 all events" | table Close src suggestion suggestion_reason asn location VirusTotal AbuseIPDB GreyNoise "Decision aid (30d)" Events | rename src AS IP, asn AS owner
| where waf_atk!="-" | stats sum(count) AS requests BY waf_atk | sort 0 - requests | rename waf_atk AS "attack type"
| where waf_class="allowed" | stats sum(count) AS requests BY waf_code | sort 0 - requests | rename waf_code AS "HTTP code"
| stats sum(count) AS requests BY waf_client waf_ua | sort 0 - requests | head 5 | rename waf_client AS client, waf_ua AS "User-Agent"
| where waf_class="blocked" OR waf_class="allowed" | timechart span=1d sum(count) BY waf_class

panel.title: History – block / unblock / not block (audit log)

search.query: | inputlookup imperva_audit where ip=$h_detail|s$ | eval _t=tonumber(time), time=strftime(_t, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), ticket=replace(coalesce(ticket, "-"), "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", "") | sort 0 - _t | table time action status user ticket description

`imperva_ioc_notables` $h_detail|s$ | `imperva_ioc_ip` | mvexpand ioc_ip | where ioc_ip=$h_detail|s$ | eval _day=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d") | stats dc(_day) AS days count AS findings min(_time) AS first max(_time) AS last values(search_name) AS rules | eval first=strftime(first, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), last=strftime(last, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), rules=mvjoin(rules, "; ") | rename days AS "detected on (days)", findings AS findings, first AS "first detected", last AS "last detected", rules AS "correlation searches"

panel.title: Neighbours detected – same /24 or same ASN (detected IPs of this page)

search.query: | `imperva_ioc_enrich_base` | eval _sel=$h_detail|s$, _c24=replace(src, "\.\d+\z", ".0/24") | eval _sel_asn1=if(src=_sel, vt_asn, null()), _sel_c241=if(src=_sel, _c24, null()) | eventstats values(_sel_asn1) AS _sel_asn values(_sel_c241) AS _sel_c24 | where src!=_sel AND (_c24=_sel_c24 OR (vt_asn=_sel_asn AND vt_asn!="-")) | eval same=if(_c24=_sel_c24, "same /24", "same ASN") | table src same asn suggestion last_detected

panel.title: All paths (30d) – highest count first · host + path without query string (🔍 all events = with query string)

search.query: | stats sum(eval(if(waf_class="blocked", count, 0))) AS Blocked sum(eval(if(waf_class="allowed", count, 0))) AS "Let through" sum(count) AS Total BY waf_path | sort 0 - Total | rename waf_path AS "host + path"

panel.title: IPs detected by WAF rules – older than 7 days, not blocked yet · WAF activity of the last 30 days (click a row to select / unselect it)

search.query: | eval _q=replace(lower(trim(replace($h_q|s$, "[*]", ""))), "^ithm[\s:#-]*", ""), _toks=split(replace(_q, "[\s,;]+", ","), ","), _hay=lower(src." ".incident_no." ".rule_name) | eval _ntok=mvcount(mvfilter(_toks!="")), _iptok=mvcount(mvfilter(match(_toks, "^[0-9a-f.:/]+\z") AND match(_toks, "[.:]"))) | eval _hit=if(coalesce(_iptok, 0)>0 AND _iptok=_ntok, coalesce(mvcount(mvmap(_toks, if(_toks!="" AND like(_hay, "%"._toks."%"), 1, null()))), 0), 0) | where _q="" OR _hit>0 OR like(_hay, "%"._q."%") | `imperva_ioc_enrich_30d` | `imperva_ioc_decision_aid(30d)`

panel.title: Not blocked (hidden) – hidden from the Block pages until detected again · click ↩ Restore to show an IP again now

search.query: | impervadismiss | eval _r=$h_refresh|s$ | eval Restore="↩ Restore", dismissed=strftime(tonumber(dismissed_at), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), incident_no=replace(coalesce(incident_no, "-"), "(?i)ITHM\s*-?\s*", "") | table Restore ip dismissed dismissed_by incident_no reason | rename dismissed AS "not blocked at", dismissed_by AS by, incident_no AS ticket, reason AS description

panel.title: Restore result – shown on the Block pages again (click a row to close)

search.query: | impervadismiss action=remove ip=$h_restore|s$ | `imperva_audit_write` | table time ip action status detail
